views.name: v_student_subject_score_detail
views.statement:
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id

properties.displayName: 学生科目成绩业务明细

views.name: v_school_subject_score_summary
views.statement:
WITH base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
)
SELECT exam_batch_id, exam_name, school_id, school_name, subject,
       COUNT(*) AS recorded_count, COUNT(score_value) AS valid_count,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(score_value) AS null_score_count,
       SUM(score_value) AS total_score,
       ROUND(AVG(score_value),2) AS average_score,
       MIN(score_value) AS min_score, MAX(score_value) AS max_score,
       MIN(full_score) AS min_full_score, MAX(full_score) AS max_full_score,
       COALESCE(SUM(pass_flag),0) AS pass_count,

       COUNT(score_value)-COUNT(pass_flag) AS unclassified_count,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(pass_flag)/NULLIF(COUNT(pass_flag),0),2) AS pass_rate
FROM base
GROUP BY exam_batch_id, exam_name, school_id, school_name, subject

views.name: v_subject_dispersion
views.statement:
WITH base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
)
SELECT exam_batch_id, exam_name, school_id, school_name, subject,
       COUNT(score_value) AS valid_count, ROUND(AVG(score_value),2) AS average_score,
       ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(score_value),2) AS sample_stdev,
       ROUND(VAR_SAMP(score_value),2) AS sample_variance,
       MIN(full_score) AS min_full_score, MAX(full_score) AS max_full_score
FROM base GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,subject

properties.description: 成绩离散程度与分化。输出粒度：批次×学校×科目。STDDEV_SAMP计算样本标准差，VAR_SAMP直接算样本方差；样本<2返回NULL。标准差/满分的10/15/20%分级和中位数另待确认，不在此SQL强行加入。 数据范围：按exam_batch_id查询指定批次；可筛学校、科目；SQL示例保留全部已记录人群，不内置在籍过滤。空组返回NULL；百分率为0–100，分母为0返回NULL。 正式发布前需确认：跨卷满分不同如何分组；是否采用10/15/20%经验分级；中位数函数支持情况

views.name: v_subject_relative_score_band
views.statement:
WITH base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), labeled AS (
SELECT *, CASE WHEN score_value IS NULL OR full_score IS NULL OR full_score<=0
                       OR score_value<0 OR score_value>full_score THEN NULL
  WHEN score_value<full_score*0.60 THEN '00_低于60%'
  WHEN score_value<full_score*0.70 THEN '01_60%-70%'
  WHEN score_value<full_score*0.80 THEN '02_70%-80%'
  WHEN score_value<full_score*0.90 THEN '03_80%-90%'
  ELSE '04_90%-100%' END AS score_band
FROM base)
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,subject,score_band,
       COUNT(*) AS band_count
FROM labeled
GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,subject,score_band

properties.description: 相对满分分数段。输出粒度：批次×学校×科目×相对分段。以满分60/70/80/90%划段，左闭右开，最高段含满分。未分类行独立NULL段，不被偷偷丢掉。 数据范围：按exam_batch_id查询指定批次；可筛学校、科目；SQL示例保留全部已记录人群，不内置在籍过滤。真实0属于低于60%段；缺成绩/缺有效满分/负分/超满分归NULL段，发布前须处理质量问题。 正式发布前需确认：分段边界是源码默认而非用户已确认；未分类不进入已分类段比例分母

views.name: v_school_city_subject_comparison
views.statement:
WITH base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), school_stats AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,subject,
       COUNT(score_value) AS school_count,AVG(score_value) AS school_avg
FROM base GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,subject
), city_stats AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,subject,COUNT(score_value) AS city_count,AVG(score_value) AS city_avg
FROM base GROUP BY exam_batch_id,subject
)
SELECT s.*,c.city_count,ROUND(c.city_avg,2) AS city_average_score,
       ROUND(s.school_avg,2) AS school_average_score,
       ROUND(s.school_avg-c.city_avg,2) AS average_score_gap
FROM school_stats s

views.name: v_school_observed_item_performance
views.statement:
WITH items AS (
SELECT sd.id AS detail_id, sd.exam_id AS paper_id, sd.student_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sc."class" AS class_name,
       e.subject, sd.question_id, sd.question_no, eq.question_type,
       CAST(sd.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_score,
       CAST(COALESCE(eq.question_score,sd.question_score) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_full_score
FROM tb_score_detail sd
JOIN tb_score sc ON sd.exam_id=sc.exam_id AND sd.student_id=sc.student_id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sd.exam_id=e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id=eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id=sch.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_question eq ON sd.question_id=eq.id AND sd.exam_id=eq.exam_id
)
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,paper_id,school_id,school_name,subject,
       question_id,question_no,question_type,item_full_score,
       COUNT(item_score) AS observed_count,ROUND(AVG(item_score),2) AS average_item_score,
       ROUND(100.0*AVG(item_score)/NULLIF(item_full_score,0),2) AS score_rate,
       ROUND(1.0-AVG(item_score)/NULLIF(item_full_score,0),4) AS difficulty_index
FROM items
GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,paper_id,school_id,school_name,subject,
         question_id,question_no,question_type,item_full_score

properties.displayName: 已记录小题表现与难度
properties.description: 已记录小题表现与难度。输出粒度：批次×试卷×学校×题目。均分=已记录非空小题分平均；得分率=均分/题满分×100；难度=1−得分率/100。不展开知识点，避免一题裂多行。 数据范围：按批次、学校、试卷、题型筛选。真实小题0分参与；NULL小题不进均分；缺行不会出现；题满分0返回NULL；负满分须先拦截质量问题。 正式发布前需确认：缺小题行是否未答0分还是缺数据；本SQL不补缺行；题目满分>0且试卷一致；与缺行补零曲线是不同口径

views.name: v_school_knowledge_mastery
views.statement:
WITH weights AS (
  SELECT question_id, knowledge_id,
         CAST(weight AS DOUBLE) /
         NULLIF(SUM(CAST(weight AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY question_id),0) AS normalized_weight
  FROM tb_exam_question_knowledge
  WHERE weight > 0
), items AS (
SELECT sd.id AS detail_id, sd.exam_id AS paper_id, sd.student_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sc."class" AS class_name,
       e.subject, sd.question_id, sd.question_no, eq.question_type,
       CAST(sd.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_score,
       CAST(COALESCE(eq.question_score,sd.question_score) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_full_score
FROM tb_score_detail sd
JOIN tb_score sc ON sd.exam_id=sc.exam_id AND sd.student_id=sc.student_id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sd.exam_id=e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id=eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id=sch.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_question eq ON sd.question_id=eq.id AND sd.exam_id=eq.exam_id
)
SELECT i.exam_batch_id, i.exam_name, i.school_id, i.school_name, i.subject,
       w.knowledge_id, COALESCE(k.knowledge_name,'未关联知识点') AS knowledge_name,
       k.ability_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.question_id) AS question_count,
       COUNT(*) AS observed_item_count,
       SUM(i.item_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) AS weighted_score,
       SUM(i.item_full_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) AS weighted_full_score,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(i.item_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) /
             NULLIF(SUM(i.item_full_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)),0),2) AS mastery_rate
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN weights w ON i.question_id=w.question_id
LEFT JOIN tb_knowledge k ON w.knowledge_id=k.id
WHERE i.item_score IS NOT NULL AND i.item_full_score > 0
GROUP BY i.exam_batch_id, i.exam_name, i.school_id, i.school_name, i.subject,
         w.knowledge_id, k.knowledge_name, k.ability_level

properties.description: 知识点加权掌握率。输出粒度：批次×学校×科目×知识点。题内正权重归一；加权得分合计/加权满分合计×100。题数按question_id去重。SQL草案仅纳入非空小题成绩且题满分>0的成对记录。 数据范围：按批次、学校、科目筛，薄弱阈值作为外层条件。0小题分保留；NULL成绩或非正满分不参与本草案比率；无知识关联归未关联知识点；先排除非法权重，不能静默修复后直接发布。 正式发布前需确认：缺行补0政策；当前草案成对排NULL与原代码某些路径不同，须确认；非法权重先修复；60%薄弱、85/70/60等级只是旧默认
